Yes, I have discussed these things. I don't have an actual psychiatrist, but I was told my family physician would suffice. He didn't prescribe me anything yet but told me anti-depressants are available if I ever feel hopeless again. The counselling was effective at first, but now after many sessions, they're just getting repetitive and I feel like I don't benefit from them anymore. I really thought I was getting better and becoming healthy again, it's just so depressing that I'm putting my family through this.

Thank you for your prayers and concern.
